d:
Houthi attacks intensify against Saudi Arabia, targeting Jeddah and Jazan ports as Red Sea security risks rise. Oil holds a two-day gain, while ADNOC imposes restrictions on tankers following attacks in the Gulf.
Markets remain volatile. Asian stocks are set to rise after a late US rebound, while the Nasdaq 100 bounces from tech-driven lows. Gold climbs back above $3,500 as yields and the dollar retreat, and copper rebounds from its lowest level this year.
